title: SikaTile-305 Master Lite Tile Adhesive 15kg
old:
SikaTile-305 Master Lite is Sika's hybrid lightweight tile adhesive: a polymer-fortified, white cement-based adhesive rated C2TES1 to AS ISO 13007. One 15kg bag goes about as far as a standard 20kg bag, so there is less weight to carry up the stairs and onto the wall, and it spreads easily with a notched trowel.

Tilers choose it for everyday wall and floor work because it is flexible, holds tiles on the wall without slipping, and gives a 30 minute open time to set tiles straight before it skins. It is made for Australian conditions and backed by Sika Australia.

Where to use it

  • Wall and floor tiling, inside and out
  • Bathrooms, laundries, wet areas and balconies
  • Residential pools and spas (concrete construction)
  • Over under-tile heating and Sika-approved acoustic underlays

Tiles it fixes

  • Ceramic and porcelain
  • Mosaics
  • Quarry and vitrified tiles
  • Natural stone that is not moisture-sensitive and is dimensionally stable

Substrates

  • Concrete (14 days old or more)
  • Cement renders and screeds
  • Sika waterproofing membranes made for direct tiling
  • Cement sheet and tile underlay boards
  • Plasterboard (internal only)
  • Existing tiles, primed with Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact

Specifications

  • Classification: C2TES1 (AS ISO 13007), flexible, non-slip, extended open time
  • Bag: 15kg, white (shade varies with local sand)
  • Coverage: about 7.5m² per bag with a 10mm notched trowel
  • Mix: 5.5 to 6 litres of clean water per bag
  • Pot life: 2 hours at 23°C
  • Open time: 30 minutes at 23°C
  • Grout and light foot traffic: 24 hours
  • Wet area service: 5 days. Pools: 21 days
  • Low VOC. Shelf life 12 months unopened

How many bags?

Divide your floor or wall area by 7.5 and round up. A 3m x 2m bathroom floor (6m²) takes one bag; add the walls and allow for notch size and back-buttering on large tiles.

Good to know

  • Prime porous and dense substrates with SikaTile-010 Secure Prime; non-porous surfaces and tile-on-tile with Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact
  • Back-butter tiles 400 x 400mm and larger
  • Not for timber substrates, moisture-sensitive stone or resin-backed tiles, and not for external walls above 3m
  • Apply between 5°C and 35°C
  • Product data sheet and safety data sheet available on request

Pick up from our Maddington showroom by appointment, or have it delivered. Shipping options show at checkout.

title: Raimondi Rai-Fix Hooks
old:
Rai-Fix stainless safety hooks sit in a slot cut in the back of wall tiles and slabs (with the Rai-Cut jig). Bedded in the adhesive, they stop heavy tiles slipping down or coming away from the wall.

Choose the hook to suit tile thickness (5mm, 6mm or 8mm and over) and the pack size.

Buy Raimondi Rai-Fix Hooks online from Excellent Tiling Services in Perth: genuine Raimondi stock for tilers, builders and DIY renovators.

Codes: RAI-RFH5500, RAI-RFH6120, RAI-RFH6500, RAI-RFH870, RAI-RFH8120, RAI-RFH8500
new:
Raimondi Rai-Fix hooks are stainless steel safety hooks that lock heavy wall tiles and slabs to the wall. Each hook sits in a slot cut into the back edge of the tile and is bedded into the adhesive, so if the bond ever lets go the tile is still held and cannot slide down or fall away.

Use it for

  • Large format and heavy wall tiles and slabs
  • Facades, high walls and areas above walkways where a falling tile is a real risk

Specifications

  • Material: stainless steel
  • Sizes: to suit 5 mm, 6 mm, and 8 mm and thicker tiles
  • Codes: RAI-RFH5500, RAI-RFH6120, RAI-RFH6500, RAI-RFH870, RAI-RFH8120, RAI-RFH8500

Good to know

  • Cut the slot with the Raimondi Rai-Cut jig so the hook sits at the right depth
  • Choose the hook by tile thickness first, then the pack size for the job
  • The hooks are a mechanical backup, not a replacement for a full adhesive bed
